skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Starseeker
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Starseeker. One of the intricate outfits worn by Astesia only in the grandest occasions of Columbia's social life. Merely donning this outfit is a statement of its own.
skins.quote: Let your heart stare hard into the stars, and witness countless flashes of glory.

skins.name: Fantastic Crafts
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Fantastic Crafts. Astesia and her sister wore this for a machine design competition. Lightweight, durable, and easy to clean, a stylish outfit for a hard-worker.
skins.quote: While her sister works on the machine for the competition, Astesia quietly goes about procuring materials, managing the schedule, testing... and preparing three meals a day for the two of them.

skins.name: Frlibe on the Palace
skins.content: Monster Siren Records Idol Project 'Shining Steps' Promotional Costume/Frlibe on the Palace. Astesia joins the project at her own expense, looking to interpret the stories written in the sky in a popular and easily accessible way.
skins.quote: Humility is left to the audience, pride belongs to the singer. This night, only I shine.
